services.name: Horseback Riding
services.desc: Trade the tasting room for a saddle. Ride the rocky, sun-baked trails above Valle de Guadalupe’s vineyards with a local guide who knows every switchback - no riding experience required. Saddle up and explore the stunning rocky landscapes of Valle de Guadalupe from a completely different angle. Our guides know the trails that open up onto the best vineyard panoramas in the valley - the kind of view worth the whole trip on its own. Rides are paced for beginners and experienced riders alike, and every horse is matched to your comfort level before you set off. services.name: Helicopter Tour
services.desc: Experience Mexico’s award-winning wine valley like never before - from 2,000 feet above. Private helicopter tours departing from the heart of Valle de Guadalupe. Up to 3 passengers. Available Thursday-Monday 12-5pm Baja Helicopter Tours provide 20-60 minute aerial experiences over Valle de Guadalupe wine country and Ensenada coastal regions, departing Thursday-Monday from a private helipad. Priced from $350 for 3 passengers (20 minutes) to premium sunset flights, these helicopter tours offer unique aerial perspectives of vineyards, Pacific Ocean coastline, and mountain ranges impossible to experience from ground level.
